Mango & Banana Smoothie Delete
By: Tamara
Published: Tuesday, February 9, 2010 - 7:36am

Ingredients




1 Mango
1 Banana
150 ml Orange juice
2 tablespoons Greek yoghurt
6 Ice cubes

Preparation

1 Roughly chop the fruit and add to a blender with the orange juice and blend well. Then add the yoghurt and ice cubes. Blend again to incorporate and serve while chilled.

About


I love smoothies but my husband has always thought of them as a bit girly.  So I was really pleased to find one he does like and he loves this one.
